directories.description: List of root directories to search for duplicates. One per line.

recurse.description: Follow subdirectories encountered within each listed directory (short option: -r).

recurse_colon.description: Follow subdirectories only for directories listed *after* this option (short option: -R; see NOTES for ordering behavior).

hardlinks.description: Treat files pointing to the same disk area as duplicates (short option: -H).

minsize.description: Consider only files >= SIZE bytes (short option: -G).

maxsize.description: Consider only files <= SIZE bytes (short option: -L).

omitfirst.description: Omit the first file in each set of duplicates (short option: -f).

sameline.description: List each set on a single line (short option: -1).

size.description: Show size of duplicate files (short option: -S).

delete.description: Prompt user to preserve files; delete the rest (short option: -d).

deferconfirmation.description: Defer byte-for-byte confirmation until just before deletion in interactive mode (short option: -D).

noprompt.description: Delete all but the first file in each set without prompting (short option: -N).

immediate.description: Delete duplicates as encountered, without grouping (short option: -I; implies --noprompt).

permissions.description: Don't consider files with different owner/group/permissions as duplicates (short option: -p).

order.description: Order files by time, ctime, or name (short option: -o).
